response.query: How will retrospective AL simulations model realistic annotator behavior (time variability, error rates, ambiguous-region rejection), and what experiments will quantify AL robustness to noisy or biased annotators?
response.answer: AL simulations model realistic annotator behavior through stochastic processes and error models. Experiments will quantify robustness using synthetic noisy or biased datasets. Results will show how well AL adapts to imperfect human input.
